I replied to Pree in a thread on their message in #central-team. I confirmed I'd noted that Tansley Parcel's signed order form is due 25 August.

I also asked one question: it's 14 October in the simulation, so 25 August has already passed this year. I asked whether they meant next year or are recording an older deadline. The brain had nothing else about this deadline, so there was nothing for it to clash with. The brain only did a keyword search, so a differently worded entry could have been missed.

A signing deadline is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to post in the team channel. Nothing else needed doing. Their channel message is already saved in the brain automatically.
